method: Demucs vocal stem -> faster-whisper large-v3 word timestamps (with and without lyric prompt, cross-checked) + vocal RMS/onset envelope. Words verified against the supplied lyric text.

sections.scene: Dream: waking on the corridor floor

lines.object: Dark-red paint on the left corridor wall (already there), found by the flashlight beam word by word
lines.camera: Starts turned to the wall, drifts forward 0.4 m; flashlight sweeps line 1 then line 2

lines.text: ну кто же мне поможет найти выход отсюда
lines.object: In-game dialogue box (typewriter, synced per word); the green 'ВЫХОД' sign over the far door flares on 'выход'
lines.camera: Turns from the wall to the corridor, ceiling lamps buzz on along the path on the kicks, walks to the door on the beat

lines.object: Red stencil stamps: on the door (5.32), left wall (5.71), right wall (6.13); the exit sign dies
lines.camera: Stops at the door, slowly steps back to see the stamps multiply

lines.text: столько проблем сейчас в моей бошке
lines.object: After the 0.5 s blackout the corridor is covered with the stamp (walls, ceiling, floor); then cascading system error windows titled 'СТОЛЬКО ПРОБЛЕМ' whose body grows 'СЕЙЧАС' -> 'СЕЙЧАС В МОЕЙ' -> 'СЕЙЧАС В МОЕЙ БОШКЕ'
lines.camera: Lights snap back on 7.04, slow push toward the door with a slight roll

lines.text: и я не знаю как мне выйти с этого круга
lines.object: The door opens onto the SAME corridor (loop). Text painted on the floor as a closed circle; letters light up as sung
lines.camera: Walks through the door, tilts down over the circle, then rotates to follow the reading position (the camera literally goes round the circle); blackout on the 12.12 kick

lines.text: на часах пять утра, я снова не сплю
lines.object: LED alarm clock: 'НА ЧАСАХ' / '05:00' / 'ПЯТЬ УТРА' light up in sync; then scratched text 'Я СНОВА НЕ СПЛЮ' under tally marks on the wall over the bed
lines.camera: Eyes open in the room, dolly in to the clock, then turn left to the wall above the bed

lines.object: CRT showing a messenger (Telegram-style) channel: status 'МОНИТОРЮ' typed in the app bar, channel header with round avatar 'ТВОЙ КАНАЛ', feed of post bubbles with view-count eyes (no invented names or text)
lines.camera: Turn to the desk, dolly in until the screen fills most of the frame

lines.object: Incoming-call window on the CRT that never connects: phone icon, 'ЗВОНКА' / 'ОТ ТЯ ЖДУ', pulsing dots
lines.camera: Holds on the screen, slow drift

lines.text: глаза слипаются я скоро попаду в царство снов
lines.object: 'ГЛАЗА СЛИПАЮТСЯ' as a status message while eyelids flutter; 'Я СКОРО ПОПАДУ' / 'В ЦАРСТВО СНОВ' as a new-area title card
lines.camera: Pulls back from the monitor, droops, falls sideways onto the pillow; eyelids close fully by 22.3

lines.object: Dialogue box (same as L2) over a slit of open eyes: lying on the floor of the first corridor again
lines.camera: Static, head on the floor, rolled 75 degrees; eyelids crack open then close

lines.object: Black game-over screen: 'ВОТ ЭТО ВОПРОС' word by word, then 'RESTART?' with '> YES / NO'; the cursor never moves
lines.camera: None (UI screen), hold to the end of the track
